provenance.author: this repository
provenance.method: slice-and-lift twice: every rank-4 decomposition of |S>^3 up to symmetry, lifted to |S>^4, none extends to |S>^5

compute.hardware: Apple silicon laptop at low priority; the first enumeration ran 2.2 hours on one core, the certificate takes about two minutes on four

notes: chi(S^3) = chi(S^4) = 4 exactly. A rank-4 decomposition of |S>^5 sliced along one qutrit gives, at the |1> slice, a rank-4 decomposition of |S>^4, itself a lift of one of |S>^3, with terms related slice to slice by a Pauli and cube roots of unity; the slice-0 equation is homogeneous because |S> has no |0> component. |S>^3 has 15 rank-4 decompositions up to its unitary symmetries (2160 in all), they lift to 69 decompositions of |S>^4, and none of those extends to |S>^5: every Pauli assignment misses the slice-2 equation by at least 1e-4 (the closest one by 0.25). The first enumeration, without the stabilizer reduction of the partner loop, took 2.2 hours and agreed orbit for orbit with the reduced one. Puts the cell at 5 <= chi <= 8.
